Class PacketDebugFormatter

java.lang.Object

    • exportPacketAsText

      public static String exportPacketAsText(PacketLogEntry entry)
      Exports the selected packet as human-readable text for analysis and sharing. Includes packet metadata, a HEX view, and the current parse tree.
      Parameters:
      entry - selected journal entry
      Returns:
      export text, or an empty string when no entry is supplied

    • exportPacketAsText

      public static String exportPacketAsText(PacketLogEntry entry, DeviceState deviceState)
      Exports the selected packet as human-readable text for analysis and sharing. The From and To fields are recalculated from MeshProtos.MeshPacket so the UI and export use the same Name (!nodeId) form regardless of how addresses were originally stored in the database.
      Parameters:
      entry - selected journal entry
      deviceState - device state used to resolve node names; may be null
      Returns:
      export text, or an empty string when no entry is supplied

    • resolvePacketEndpoints

      public static PacketDebugFormatter.PacketEndpoints resolvePacketEndpoints(PacketLogEntry entry, DeviceState deviceState)
      Returns from/to labels for an already stored packet entry. The method does not trust database strings first: parsing MeshProtos.MeshPacket from packet_bytes has priority, and stored entry values are used only as fallbacks.
      Parameters:
      entry - journal entry
      deviceState - device state used to resolve node names; may be null
      Returns:
      sender and recipient labels suitable for the table and text export

    • resolvePacketEndpoints

      public static PacketDebugFormatter.PacketEndpoints resolvePacketEndpoints(byte[] packetBytes, DeviceState deviceState)
      Parses top-level from/to fields directly from packet bytes.
      Parameters:
      packetBytes - serialized MeshProtos.MeshPacket
      deviceState - device state used to resolve node names; may be null
      Returns:
      sender and recipient labels; both values are null if parsing fails

    • exportPacketAsJson

      public static String exportPacketAsJson(PacketLogEntry entry)
      Exports only the MeshProtos.MeshPacket content as protobuf-style JSON. The format deliberately omits desktop-client fields so the result can be pasted into the original Meshtastic web application.
      Parameters:
      entry - selected journal entry
      Returns:
      packet JSON, or an empty string if the packet is missing or cannot be parsed

    • exportPacketsAsJson

      public static String exportPacketsAsJson(List<PacketLogEntry> entries, PacketDebugFormatter.PacketCollectionExportMetadata metadata, Function<PacketLogEntry, DeviceState> deviceStateResolver)
      Exports packets to a hierarchical JSON file using the current UI filters. Unlike exportPacketAsJson(PacketLogEntry), this format includes export/filter metadata, desktop metadata for each journal entry, the protobuf packet structure, decoded payloads when they can be parsed, and the packet hierarchy tree with byte ranges.
      Parameters:
      entries - entries to include in the file
      metadata - export metadata; may be null
      deviceStateResolver - device-state resolver used to normalize node names; may be null
      Returns:
      pretty-printed JSON
